items.source: If the method parameter type is Map and a matrix variable name is specified, then the matrix variable value is converted to a Map assuming an appropriate conversion strategy is available.
items.translation: 如果方法参数类型为 Map 且指定了矩阵变量名，则假设存在适当的转换策略，将矩阵变量值转换为 Map。

items.source: If the method parameter is Map<String, String> or MultiValueMap<String, String> and a variable name is not specified, then the map is populated with all matrix variable names and values.
items.translation: 如果方法参数是Map<String, String>或MultiValueMap<String, String>，且未指定变量名，则使用所有矩阵变量名称和值填充该 Map。

items.source: Default is true, leading to an exception being thrown in case the variable is missing in the request. Switch this to false if you prefer a null if the variable is missing.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，如果请求中缺少该变量，将抛出异常。如果您希望在变量缺失时返回 `null`，请将其切换为 `false`。

items.source: Alternatively, provide a defaultValue(), which implicitly sets this flag to false.
items.translation: 或者，提供一个defaultValue()，这将隐式地将此标志设置为false。

items.source: The name of the matrix variable.

The name of the URI path variable where the matrix variable is located,
if necessary for disambiguation (for example, a matrix variable with the same
name present in more than one path segment).
items.translation: 矩阵变量所在的路径变量名称，在必要时用于消除歧义（例如，当多个路径段中存在同名矩阵变量时）。

items.source: Supplying a default value implicitly sets required() to false.
items.translation: 隐式提供默认值会将required()设置为false。

items.source: The default value to use as a fallback.
Whether the matrix variable is required.
